english: The road behind the Hanuman Mandir has such a big pothole that an auto almost overturned.
Ajmal Khan Road in Karol Bagh is pitch dark at night; the bulbs on the poles have fused.
There is a huge heap of filth near Fatehpuri Masjid in Chandni Chowk, and flies are buzzing around.
In Daryaganj, opposite Golcha Cinema, drinking water is gushing out from under the ground.
The gutter is overflowing in the Rajinder Nagar market and the shopkeepers are troubled by the stench. After rain the whole road turns into a pond.
The direction board at the Mandi House roundabout is hanging upside down.
Carts have encroached on the footpath near Meherchand Market in Lodhi Colony; there is no room to walk.
In Lane No. 4 of Paharganj, children going to school walk through heaps of garbage.
My electricity bill has come too high, where do I complain?
The water line in N Block of Connaught Place is broken; thousands of litres of water have flowed away since morning.
In Chanakyapuri, opposite the gate of Nehru Park, the sewer cover is broken and dirty water is coming out; yesterday a biker fell into it.
The No Parking board on C-Hexagon near India Gate has broken and fallen.
A big pothole has formed in the road outside the Gurdwara Sahib in Karol Bagh; a rickshaw overturned and the passenger was injured.
All the lights in the lane near Bangla Sahib Gurdwara are off; it feels scary at night.
There are heaps of filth in the Main Bazaar of Paharganj; the cleaners haven't come for a week.
The drinking water pipe in front of our house in Rajinder Nagar has burst; water has been flowing for three days.
In Daryaganj, dirty sewage water has filled the lanes; children can't go to school.
The parking board on the Outer Circle of Connaught Place has tilted and is about to fall.
A tangle of electric wires is hanging near Sis Ganj Gurdwara in Chandni Chowk.
When will my ration card be made?
In Lodhi Colony, the road opposite the park is broken up in many places.
The drain near Gol Market is choked with plastic; the water doesn't flow on.
Garbage is burning in front of the school gate in Chanakyapuri; the children have started coughing.
The pole light near the India Gate lawns keeps flickering on and off all night.
Brother, the road below Karol Bagh metro station has such a big pothole that a car's tyre got stuck.
All the street lamps in the Chuna Mandi lane in Paharganj have fused; chain snatching is happening at night.
The MCD garbage dump behind Gol Market hasn't been cleared for 1 week; all the garbage has come onto the road.
The pipeline near Block A of Rajiv Chowk has burst; all the water is flowing onto the road and it is knee-deep.
The gutter on Netaji Subhash Marg in Daryaganj is overflowing; the stench makes life difficult.
Some truck hit the Keep Left board at the Mandi House circle; now it is lying bent.
In front of the Lodhi Colony market, monkeys are snatching things from people's hands.
Brother, when will my Paytm refund come?
Outside the school near Race Course, the speed breaker has broken and potholes have formed; children fall off their bicycles every day.
The Jal Board line on Malcha Marg in Chanakyapuri is leaking; the pressure is zero.
The drain on Shahjahan Road near India Gate is blocked; after the rain, water has filled up to 2 feet.
The garbage collection vehicle didn't come.
